title: Utility and Infrastructure Classes

classes.name: DBUtil
classes.notes: Singleton-style DB connection; reads db.connectionString, db.driverName, db.username, db.password from ResourceBundle 'application'. closeConnection(Connection) is a no-op stub (body commented out).

classes.name: IDUtil
classes.notes: Generates timestamp-based IDs. generateId() returns 'P' + yyyyMMddhhmmss; generateTransId() returns 'T' + yyyyMMddhhmmss. Uses SimpleDateFormat + new Date().

classes.name: MailMessage
methods: + transactionSuccess(recipientEmail: String, name: String, transId: String, transAmount: double): void {static}
+ orderShipped(recipientEmail: String, name: String, transId: String, transAmount: double): void {static}
+ productAvailableNow(recipientEmail: String, name: String, prodName: String, prodId: String): void {static}
+ sendMessage(toEmailId: String, subject: String, htmlTextMessage: String): String {static}
classes.notes: All methods delegate to JavaMailUtil.sendMail(). sendMessage() returns 'SUCCESS' or 'FAILURE'. Builds HTML email bodies inline.

classes.name: JavaMailUtil
methods: ~ sendMail(recipient: String, subject: String, htmlTextMessage: String): void {static} throws MessagingException
- prepareMessage(session: Session, myAccountEmail: String, recipientEmail: String): Message {static}
- prepareMessage(session: Session, myAccountEmail: String, recipientEmail: String, subject: String, htmlTextMessage: String): Message {static}
classes.notes: SMTP via smtp.gmail.com:587 with STARTTLS. Reads mailer.email and mailer.password from ResourceBundle 'application'. Uses jakarta.mail Session/Transport/MimeMessage. The 3-arg sendMail(recipient, subject, htmlTextMessage) is package-protected (~).

classes.name: IUserConstants
classes.notes: Constant interface — all fields are implicitly public static final. Used by DAO/service classes that implement this interface to reference DB column names.

relationships: MailMessage depends_on JavaMailUtil (calls JavaMailUtil.sendMail() in all methods)
DBUtil uses PreparedStatement (parameter in closeConnection overload)
DBUtil uses ResultSet (parameter in closeConnection overload)
key_dependencies: JavaMailUtil → jakarta.mail.{Session, Transport, Message, Authenticator, MimeMessage}
design_patterns: DBUtil: lazy singleton connection (static field + null/closed check)
MailMessage + JavaMailUtil: facade/template — MailMessage is a high-level facade over JavaMailUtil's SMTP mechanics
important_notes: All utility classes use only static methods — they are utility/helper classes, not instantiated objects. DBUtil.closeConnection(Connection) body is entirely commented out (no-op). JavaMailUtil has two overloaded sendMail variants with different visibility (public vs package-protected). IUserConstants is implemented by DAO/service classes for column name constants.
